subject.title: fix(secrets): resolve active exec refs locally

question: Should command resolution use this PR’s split boundary—active exec-backed paths resolve locally first while non-exec paths continue through the gateway snapshot—or should any active exec ref move the whole command target set to local resolution?
rationale: Both approaches fix the log noise but differ in credential execution timing, snapshot consistency, and the amount of secret resolution moved into the local reply process.

options.title: Use split per-path resolution
options.body: Keep this PR’s narrower boundary after an exact-head refresh and live proof, preserving gateway snapshot resolution for non-exec targets.

options.title: Use whole-command local resolution
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96661 and accept that one active exec target causes all command targets to resolve locally.

recommendation.title: Use split per-path resolution
recommendation.body: Keep this PR’s narrower boundary after an exact-head refresh and live proof, preserving gateway snapshot resolution for non-exec targets.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current canonical resolver and are already assigned to the competing implementation.
